final: SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') AS funding_source, COUNT(*) AS qc_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 1000 AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 250 AS count_divided_by_avg FROM scanqc sq JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') ORDER BY qc_count DESC
